user.title: Connect the Housewright bridge
user.description: The bridge is a small Housewright program that runs next to Home Assistant (or as its add-on). Enter its address and the token it printed when it first started (also in its data folder as api-token).

pair.title: Add the bridge to your household
pair.description: This bridge is not in a household yet. In the Housewright app, open Settings, Sync and devices, Add a device or person, and choose Home Assistant. Type the code it shows here. The sync server is only needed if you type the code without it. {error}

compare.title: Compare the numbers
compare.description: The bridge shows **{safety_number}**. Check that the Housewright app shows the same six digits. If they differ, leave this unticked: someone may be in between.

finish.title: Finish in the app
finish.description: Now tap "They match" in the Housewright app, then press Submit here.

reauth_confirm.title: New bridge token
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge did not accept the saved token. Enter the token from the bridge's data folder (api-token).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bridge at that address. Check that it is running.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge did not accept that token.
error.not_a_bridge: Something answered at that address, but it is not a Housewright bridge.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing did not work. Get a new code in the app and try again.
error.not_finished: The app has not finished yet. Tap "They match" in the app, then press Submit again.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.

menu_options.import_devices: Add Home Assistant devices to Housewright
menu_options.link_meter: Send a sensor's number to a meter
menu_options.link_event: Report an event when a sensor changes

data.scan_interval: How often to check for changes

data_description.default_member: Leave empty to record it as done via Home Assistant, with no person named.

import_devices.title: Add devices
import_devices.description: These devices look like things Housewright has maintenance plans for, and are not in Housewright yet. Each one you pick is added with its tasks as suggestions; switch on the ones you want in the app.

imported.title: Added
imported.description: Added: {added}. Their tasks are waiting as suggestions in the app.

link_meter.title: Send a sensor's number to a meter
link_meter.description: For example, an HVAC runtime-hours sensor or a washer cycle counter. The bridge keeps at most one reading every 30 minutes.

link_event.title: Report an event
link_event.description: For example, a leak sensor under the water heater, or a smoke alarm's low-battery sensor. When the entity turns to the state below, Housewright is told, and the matching task becomes due.

abort.no_devices: No new devices look like things Housewright knows about.
abort.no_meters: None of your things in Housewright has a meter yet (a washing machine's loads, for example).
abort.no_items: There are no things in Housewright yet.

no_household.message: No Housewright household is set up.

which_household.message: More than one Housewright household is set up; say which with config_entry_id.
